display_description: One-click MiniCPM desk pet + OpenVINO inference backend (Intel AI PC only)
detail_describe: Deploy a complete MiniCPM desk-pet playground on local Intel AI PC hardware. The backend runs the MiniCPM5-1B INT8 model on OpenVINO, and the frontend launches the Electron desk-pet app from source. After deploy, chat with the pet locally, with Hybrid Reasoning support, no network needed.
